title: About Our Y
content:
Welcome

The YMCA of Madison County serves over 30,000 members across 5 branches. Our mission focuses on youth development, healthy living, and social responsibility.

Our Values

  • Caring
  • Honesty
  • Respect
  • Responsibility
The Y is more than a gym - it's a community where everyone belongs.
